name: Yash Kulkarni
summary: Software engineer with five years of experience building reliable web products, from data-heavy dashboards to customer-facing platforms. I care about clear interfaces, well-tested code, and systems that stay easy to change. Currently focused on full-stack TypeScript and cloud infrastructure.

points: Led the rebuild of the customer analytics dashboard, cutting median page load from 4.2s to 1.1s.
Designed an event pipeline processing 20M records a day with zero data loss over twelve months.
Mentored four engineers and introduced a code review checklist adopted across three teams.
Built the self-serve onboarding flow that raised trial-to-paid conversion by 18%.
Migrated a monolithic API to services on AWS, reducing deploy time from 40 minutes to 6.
Wrote the integration test suite that brought release regressions down by half.
Shipped an internal scheduling tool used daily by a team of 30.
Automated weekly reporting, saving roughly six hours of manual work per week.
